Contract ManageUserCRUDService::deleteUser(userid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		ob: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = userid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		ob.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		User.allInstance()->excludes(ob) and
		result = true or
		ob.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
